{
  "name": "schedule_joint_meeting",
  "request_shape": "Find a free one-hour slot next week that works for both Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor, and propose it to them.",
  "inputs": [],
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "get_dana_availability",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "dana_slots",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "Dana Reyes free slots next week"
    },
    {
      "id": "get_sam_availability",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "sam_slots",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "Sam Okafor free slots next week"
    },
    {
      "id": "find_common_slots",
      "kind": "check_coverage",
      "inputs": ["dana_slots", "sam_slots"],
      "output": "common_slots",
      "rule": "intersection of dana_slots and sam_slots where duration is exactly 60 minutes"
    },
    {
      "id": "select_proposal_slot",
      "kind": "classify",
      "inputs": ["common_slots"],
      "output": "selected_slot",
      "question": "Which slot is the earliest available?",
      "enum": ["earliest", "latest", "mid_week", "morning", "afternoon"]
    },
    {
      "id": "draft_proposal",
      "kind": "write",
      "inputs": ["selected_slot", "dana_slots", "sam_slots"],
      "output": "proposal_text",
      "instruction": "Draft a polite message proposing the selected time slot to Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor.",
      "max_words": 50
    },
    {
      "id": "verify_proposal",
      "kind": "check_coverage",
      "inputs": ["proposal_text", "selected_slot"],
      "output": "final_proposal",
      "rule": "proposal_text must contain the date and time of selected_slot"
    }
  ],
  "output": "final_proposal"
}
